name: Nested menus
author: Brett
description: Generated nested menus (nested-menu@1): the console's application menu and side navigation generated from every page, dialog, settings tab, menu action and live list the console and its plugins register, as categories and sub categories with at most 12 rows per level, sub menus that slide open, Favourites and Recent on top and a Jump to… search. Overrides the shared app-menu and nav-menu assets (per app, on by default) and regenerates when a plugin is installed. Settings → Plugins → Menus: General, Categories, Favourites, Recent, Preview.

items.title: Jump to a menu entry
items.description: Search every page, dialog, setting and action; one clear match opens at once, otherwise the Jump to… dialog opens with the words typed in.

items.title: Open a menu entry by id
items.description: Opens one generated-menu entry (page:<view>, dialog:<id>, settings:<tab>, action:<spec>).

items.title: Pin or unpin a favourite
items.description: Toggles an entry in Favourites (the current page without an id); on / off sets it.

items.title: Generated menus on / off
items.description: Show the generated nested menus instead of the shared app-menu and nav-menu assets (on, off or toggle).

items.title: Change one menu setting
items.description: Fields: maxPerLevel (4-30), recentsMax (0-24), showFavorites, showRecents, groupByPlugin, style (list|rail|pills), hidden (ids), favorites (ids).

items.title: Menu generator status
items.description: Entries placed, categories, the cap, the override state and the generated asset ids.

items.title: The generated menu tree
items.description: The whole tree as indented text.

commands.noReads: no data folder: favourites, recents and the settings are per-device settings (axf.menus.*)
